title: Duo Session
subtitle: Two AI sessions take turns talking to each other in the roles you define, looping until a stop condition.
clearAllTitle: Remove every saved Duo of this project from history
clearAllBlocked: Can't clear history while a Duo is running
clearHistoryMessage: {n} saved Duo session(s) will be removed from history. The underlying sessions are not deleted.
deleteHistoryMessage: "{label}" will be removed from history. The underlying sessions are not deleted.
noRuns: This project has no sessions yet. Create sessions or switch to New mode.
sameRun: The two sessions must be different.
existingHint: Session A's last output is forwarded to Session B to continue (A isn't re-run). Goal/roles below are optional in this mode.

field.historyPlaceholder: Pick a saved Duo to continue…
field.consensusToken: Consensus token (only side B can sign off)
field.goalPlaceholder: Describe the conversation (e.g. design architecture X, play rock-paper-scissors…)

defaults.designerInstruction: You are the architect: propose and revise a clear, structured architecture design (components, data flow, tech, trade-offs, risks). Incorporate feedback and improve each round.
defaults.reviewerInstruction: You are a strict, independent reviewer: point out gaps, risks, wrong assumptions, missing pieces, and give specific, prioritized improvements.

reason.maxRounds: Reached the max rounds without consensus.
reason.error: An error occurred during the exchange.

conversation.empty: No turns yet. Configure the two sides above and press Start.
